name: @messanga11/workspace
description: Provider-agnostic business kernel and reference adapters for Messanga11 applications.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @messanga11/core && npm run build -w @messanga11/formbuilder && npm run build -w @messanga11/adapter-refine && npm run build -w @messanga11/adapter-sqlite && npm run build -w @messanga11/tenancy && npm run build -w @messanga11/auth-oidc && npm run build -w @messanga11/adapter-redis && npm run build -w @messanga11/telemetry && npm run build -w @messanga11/adapter-postgres && npm run build -w @messanga11/project-fixture && npm run build -w @messanga11/next-fixture && npm run build -w @messanga11/expo-fixture
scripts.release: npm run build && npm run check:packages && npm run check:tarballs && npm run check:fixtures && changeset publish
